title: Award Winning Penthouse in Nashville
description:
Our extraordinary Penthouse sets a new bar for luxury living in Nashville. With 960 square feet of living space, it contains everything you need for a personalized, utterly sophisticated stay. Enjoy an alfresco cocktail on the adjoining terrace, or warm up by the brick fireplace in chilly weather.  Doors open to reveal the magnificent bedroom, with its California King four-poster bed, generous dressing area, and oversized bathroom with a deep soaking tub and dual-head shower stall.

The space
Enjoy our penthouse suite, featuring:

Full kitchen
Large living room area with gas fireplace
Two grand chandeliers
Italian dining table with seating for up to 10 guests
42-foot balcony
Dressing area
Dual vanity
Deep soaking tub
Walk-in, dual-head shower with Spanish porcelain tile
Ceiling fan

121 provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

Other things to note
Home Truths:
- We allow service animals at this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note that there are ring cameras that monitor the hotel hallways for guest security. There are no cameras inside the rooms.
- Please note that this is a self-service hotel with contactless check-in and no staff on site.
